releaseNotes:
- fix(combos): publish the catalogue window a combo can actually serve (9f6c04c)
- gemini-flash 128000 -> 1048576, minimax-model 128000 -> 1048576, nemotron-model 128000 -> 1048576, deepseek-model 131072 -> 1050000, glm-model 131072 -> 1049000, meta-model 128000 -> 163840
- a combo seat written without a provider (gemini-3.8-flash) was being skipped, which dropped the whole combo back to its name-based guess
- a combo seat carrying a sub-route (z-ai/glm-5.2-free/nvidia/nemotron-3-...) had its model truncated to one segment, so it reported the route provider's limits for a model that provider does not host
- combos now report the largest window across their seats rather than the smallest, so one small helper seat no longer drags a 1M combo down to 128K
- catalogue rows whose output ceiling equals their context window are ignored
- new combos pick this up automatically, with no restart or rebuild

---
Update from the dashboard (sidebar button) or run `9router-go --update`.
